{{Short description|Swiss mathematician (1953–2022)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2023}}
'''Thomas Kappeler''' (12 February 1953 – 30 May 2022) was a Swiss mathematician and professor at the [[University of Zurich]].<ref name="NZZ1">[https://zeitungsarchiv.nzz.ch/read/1563673/1563673/2022-06-04/12 ''Thomas Kappeler.''] Obituary in ''[[Neue Zürcher Zeitung]].'' 4. Juni 2022, P. 12, page accessed 24 February 2023.</ref><ref>[https://www.math.ch/index2022.php ''News, and Preview of significant forthcoming events:''] Obituary in math.ch</ref>
Kappeler's main research was in [[global analysis]], [[partial differential equation]]s and [[dynamical system]]s in infinite dimensions.

Kappeler co-founded ''the Zurich Graduate School in Mathematics'', a joint doctoral program of the Mathematics departments of [[ETH Zurich]] and University of Zurich.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.zgsm.ch/index.php?id=682|title=Zurich Graduate School in Mathematics - Announcement|publisher=Zurich Graduate School in Mathematics|access-date=24 February 2023}}</ref> He also actively supported young kids with talent in mathematics. He was the co-leader of the children's math club ''Junior Euler Society''.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://zeitungsarchiv.nzz.ch/read/124687/124687/2013-10-03/15|title=Masslösung für ein Mathe-Genie|work=Neue Zürcher Zeitung|date=3 October 2013|page=15|access-date=24 February 2022}}</ref>

== Life ==
Kappeler studied mathematics at ETH Zurich, where he did his Ph.D. in 1981 under the supervision of [[Corneliu Constantinescu]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=121732}}</ref> He was a visiting professor at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], the [[University of Pennsylvania]], [[Brandeis University]] and [[Brown University]]. He was a professor at [[Ohio State University]] from 1990 till 1996.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://typeset.io/authors/thomas-kappeler-3b1fc53kh2|title=Thomas Kappeler |website=typeset.io |access-date=1 March 2023}}</ref> After that he became a mathematics professor at University of Zurich.<ref name="UZH">{{cite web|url=https://www.math.uzh.ch/index.php?id=people&key1=113|title=Prof. Dr. Thomas Kappeler|publisher=Universität Zürich|date=18 November 2021| access-date=4 June 2022}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
Kappeler published more than 150 research articles.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/98125|title=Kappeler, Thomas|publisher=American Mathematical Society|website=mathscinet.ams.org|access-date=27 February 2023}}</ref> He also published two books on partial differential equations.

* {{cite journal|first1=Dan|last1=Burghelea|author-link1=Dan Burghelea|first2=Leonid|last2=Friedlander|first3=Thomas|last3=Kappeler|title=Mayer-Vietoris type formula for determinants of elliptic differential operators|journal=[[Journal of Functional Analysis]]|volume=107|date=1992|issue=1 |pages=34–65|doi=10.1016/0022-1236(92)90099-5}}
* {{cite journal|title=The Miura map on the line|first1=Thomas|last1=Kappeler|first2=Peter A.|last2=Perry|first3=Mikhail A.|last3=Shubin|author-link3=Mikhail Shubin (mathematician)|first4=Peter|last4=Topalov|journal=[[International Mathematics Research Notices]]|date=2005| volume=2005|issue=50 |doi=10.1155/IMRN.2005.3091|pages=3091–3133 |doi-access=<!-- Not free-->|s2cid=9065483 |url=https://www.zora.uzh.ch/id/eprint/21729/1/0506411v1.pdf }}
* {{cite journal|first1=Thomas|last1=Kappeler|first2=Peter|last2=Topalov|title=Global wellposedness of KdV in H−1(T,R)|journal=[[Duke Mathematical Journal]]|volume=135|number=2|pages=327–360|date=1 November 2006|doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-06-13524-X}}

* {{cite journal|title=Nekhoroshev theorem for the periodic Toda lattice|journal=[[Chaos (journal)|Chaos]]|volume=19|number=3|date=2009|doi=10.1063/1.3196783|first1=Andreas|last1=Henrici|first2=Thomas|last2=Kappeler|page=033120 |pmid=19792000 |arxiv=0812.4912 |bibcode=2009Chaos..19c3120H |s2cid=18290712 }}
